summary: Added the SHACL path parser as two new files, with nothing else touched and nothing committed. rdflib/extras/shacl.py holds SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier), following the seven-step procedure in the spec and using graph.items() for list iteration. test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py has a module-scoped Turtle fixture, one parametrized test covering all valid cases and each error branch, and a second test checking that None and a plain string raise SHACLPathError and that the graph is unchanged. Tests run with the generator venv Python: the new tests plus test/test_path.py give 39 passed. Not verified: mypy and ruff are not installed in the venv and I was not allowed to install them, so the type-ignore placement and the 88-column limit were checked by reading only (awk found no line over 88).
